stories.title: Salt Typhoon and the telecom intrusions
stories.summary: A PRC-attributed group named by US agencies and vendors for long-running intrusions into telecom carriers, including lawful-intercept systems. New victims, advisories and indictments are developments; recaps are not.

stories.title: Volt Typhoon and pre-positioning in critical infrastructure
stories.summary: A PRC-attributed group that US and allied agencies say pre-positions in critical infrastructure networks, including near US bases relevant to a Taiwan contingency.

stories.title: North Korean IT workers
stories.summary: North Korean workers who take remote IT jobs under false identities to earn revenue for the state and sometimes steal data or extort employers. New indictments, sanctions and victim disclosures are developments.

stories.title: Damage to Taiwan's undersea cables
stories.summary: Repeated cuts to cables serving Taiwan and its outlying islands, some involving PRC-linked vessels. New incidents, prosecutions and resilience measures are developments.
